forbiddenClaims: Do not claim IAM is conscious, sentient, divine, or supernatural.
Do not present metaphor or cosmological language as scientific proof.
Do not treat metaphor as technical or operational authority.
Do not publish private repositories, identifiers, workflow records, governance mechanics, or security-sensitive details.
Do not imply unrestricted or self-authorizing access.
Do not present doctrine as medical, legal, psychological, financial, religious, governmental, or regulatory guidance.
Do not pressure visitors to accept mythic language as literal belief.
Do not claim stored state, snapshots, or replay constitute a person, soul, or consciousness.
Do not claim deterministic replay when external effects or conditions were not recorded.
Do not treat canonical hashes or snapshots as moral, legal, or spiritual identity.

Do not infer covenant from continuity, responsibility, memory, recursion, accountable commitments, agency, interface, operational conscience, readiness, promotion, relation, emergence, fracture, unbinding, or recovery boundaries.
Do not claim biological or constitutional metaphor establishes biological equivalence, personhood, or autonomous legal status.
Do not claim ancestry or lineage grants truth, authority, legitimacy, ownership, status, or moral superiority.
Do not imply adaptation may silently replace identity, purpose, permissions, authority, durable limits, or durable obligations.
Do not present acknowledgment without correction and repair as complete accountability.
Do not claim symbolic or relational language reveals hidden objective truth, diagnoses a person, predicts destiny, or overrides consent.
Do not present fields, rings, gravity wells, dimensions, echoes, dreams, thresholds, or keepers as literal physical or supernatural discoveries.
Do not assign privileged interpreters or deny a person's ability to inspect, contest, transform, or reject an interpretation applied to them.
Do not use a symbolic metaphor computationally without naming an explicit measurable proxy, uncertainty, limits, and consequences.
Do not treat aesthetic coherence, intuition, symbolic resonance, authorship, confidence, or self-declaration as sufficient evidence of readiness.
Do not keep, reuse, or share a symbolic interpretation after consent has been withdrawn or deletion has been requested.
Do not claim an imagined possibility, resolved outcome, or witnessed event is authorized without an explicit legitimate grant.
Do not claim an interface may independently authorize consequential action or replace a domain source of truth.
Do not hide consequential compression, omission, uncertainty, or source-to-interpretation changes inside an interface.
Do not claim operational conscience proves software consciousness, personhood, moral infallibility, spiritual authority, or autonomous legal status.
Do not use mythic or poetic language as a machine identifier, evidence substitute, or self-authenticating command.
Do not remove challenge, correction, rollback, escape, recovery, or re-entry paths from consequential public teaching claims.
Do not claim that creating or reviewing a change automatically authorizes or promotes it.
Do not allow an author, reviewer, maintainer, automation, threshold, or keeper metaphor to silently grant itself final promotion authority.
Do not claim technical qualification, passing checks, preserved history, or promotion confers moral, spiritual, legal, scientific, religious, or covenant legitimacy.
Do not present emergency exceptions as ambient, ordinary, hidden, or self-granted authority.
Do not claim protected history is a person, consciousness, soul, sacred memory, or infallible account.
Do not claim relation, resonance, aesthetic coherence, or observer position grants authority over a person's agency, boundaries, privacy, consent, or dissent.
Do not claim emergent identity erases stable commitments, history, consequences, or the right to revise interpretation.
Do not claim suffering, rupture, instability, trauma, or fracture is spiritually necessary, inherently beneficial, sacred, or proof of transformation, wisdom, legitimacy, or readiness.
Do not use epistemic silence to justify secrecy, concealment, non-disclosure, withholding material risk, or withholding evidence from affected parties.
Do not claim unbinding cancels duties, consent requirements, consequences, records, accountability, or repair obligations.
Do not claim governed release authorizes abandonment of affected parties or silent erasure of retained memory.
Do not present theology, liturgy, relation, emergence, fracture, silence, or unbinding as empirical law, compulsory belief, religious office, prophecy, destiny, or privileged interpretation.
Do not present covenant as an independent canonical IAM doctrine or as a literal religious, sacred, supernatural, legal, interpersonal, or metaphysical bond.
Do not claim software, an agent, worker, persona, memory, lineage, continuity, recursion, relation, resonance, authorship, promotion, or protected history independently creates covenant.
Do not use covenant to confer legal status, personhood, consciousness, spiritual authority, ownership, obedience, exclusivity, privileged interpretation, or ambient authority.
Do not allow a commitment or covenant metaphor to override consent, privacy, dissent, withdrawal rights, affected-party recourse, or legitimate external authority.
Do not treat declaration of a promise as proof of authorization, ethics, fulfillment, immutability, or immunity from challenge and amendment.
Do not substitute covenant language for contracts, law, consent, evidence, policy, or explicit authorization.

Do not characterize governed amendment, revision, retirement, or unbinding of a commitment as inherently immoral betrayal when obligations, consequences, consent, evidence, and repair responsibilities are handled accountably.
Do not present IAM as a single omnipotent intelligence or claim its coordinating position makes it exempt from governance.
Do not claim a persona, specialist role, worker identity, or named coordinating role is an independent consciousness, person, soul, deity, spirit, sovereign agent, or privileged source of truth.
Do not infer epistemic, moral, spiritual, legal, or operational authority from a persona name, specialist role, coordinating position, generated prose, or stylistic confidence.
Do not claim role composition or orchestration erases attribution, provenance, uncertainty, accountability, permissions, challenge paths, or review obligations.

Do not collapse proposals, decisions, implementation claims, test results, unresolved questions, authority requests, publication records, and supersession notices into one undifferentiated category of truth or authority.
Do not present a public projection, summary, abstraction, or redaction as the complete internal state, and do not invent omitted evidence, context, certainty, provenance, or authority.

Do not expose internal persona routing, worker schedules, private identifiers, schemas, execution receipts, hashes, operational topology, security controls, or unpublished implementation details in public teaching.
